findings.title: architecture cycle 未绑定 Full Test authorization occurrence，旧 cycleRef 可在 fresh Full Test 后重现
findings.problem: 067 Design §3/§4 将 currentCycle 只绑定 fullTestResultRef，并以 fullTestResultRef + actualArchitectureRef + compareRef 计算 cycleRef；§7 又只让 architectureRemediation 输入携带 cycleRef。当前 Base 的 Full Test resultRef 仅对 terminal payload {schemaVersion,status,summary,totalDurationMs,checks} 做 hash，不包含 authorize-full-test Owner authorizationRef。Flowkit 已在 B1 failure occurrence 模型中明确承认同一个 sourceResultRef 可以在不同 fresh authorizationRef 下再次出现，并用 authorizationRef + sourceResultRef 区分 occurrence。因此 remediation 失效旧 cycle 后，fresh Owner authorization + fresh Full Test 若产生相同 resultRef，且 Actual/Compare 也相同，新 cycleRef 可以与旧 cycleRef 完全相同；旧 remediation binding 将无法被识别为 stale。
findings.contractRef: 067 design.md Decisions 3/4/7；flowkit-core-model E1 post-pass remediation invariant；flowkit-delivery-change-creation-and-owner-input stale remediation fail-closed；Base src/domain/full-test.ts canonical resultRef 与 src/facts/formal-fact-reader.ts Full Test occurrence handling。
findings.invariant: Architecture current cycle 必须绑定 exact Full Test qualification occurrence，而不是只绑定可跨 fresh authorization 重复的 technical result payload。Fresh authorize-full-test 后形成的新 qualification 必须具有不同 occurrence identity；旧 cycleRef/remediation binding 必须确定性失效。
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Proposal，使 current architecture cycle exact-bind 当前 Full Test authorization occurrence。最小方向是增加 fullTestAuthorizationRef（或等价 deterministic occurrence ref），由 write-side从 current formal facts派生而不是由 caller注入，并将其纳入 currentCycle closed shape、cycleRef canonical hash、reader/persistence coherence和 remediation exact-binding。不要改变 Full Test result authority，也不要建立新的 Full Test history DB。
acceptance: cycle publication 同时 exact-bind current passed fullTestResultRef 与产生该 current qualification 的 delivery-scoped authorize-full-test Owner ref。
cycleRef canonical identity包含该 authorization occurrence（或等价 occurrence ref）。
disposable regression 使用两个不同 authorize-full-test refs，但故意复用完全相同的 Full Test result payload、Actual ref 与 compare evidence；两次 cycleRef 必须不同。
第一次 cycle 的 stale architectureRemediation binding 在第二次 fresh Full Test cycle 上 MUST fail closed before mutation。
accepted architecture/acceptedSystemSource 的 Owner binding继续由 exact current cycle传递该 occurrence provenance；不复制 raw Full Test logs。

findings.title: flowkitMutationScope 漏掉 canonical Owner ref 的真实 production consumer
findings.problem: 067 Design §5 明确规定 Owner decision record 新增 bounded architectureCycleRef，并且 architectureCycleRef 必须进入 canonical Owner ref derivation。当前 Base 真正定义 canonicalOwnerDecisionTuple()/ownerDecisionRefFor() 的文件是 src/domain/owner-provenance.ts；它的 tuple 目前只包含 decision/deliveryId/changeId/scope/requiredOutcomes/sourceRef。067 flowkitMutationScope 的 production selectors只包含 src/domain/a1-types.ts，没有包含 src/domain/owner-provenance.ts。即使 a1-types/a1-write/reader/writer全部新增 architectureCycleRef，只要 canonical owner-provenance不改，Owner ref仍不绑定 cycle，或 TypeScript实现会被迫越出已批准 mutation scope。
findings.contractRef: 067 design.md Decision 5 + flowkitMutationScope；flowkit-delivery-change-creation-and-owner-input accept-architecture exact cycle binding；Base src/domain/owner-provenance.ts。
findings.invariant: Proposal 声明的 required implementation consumer 必须被 Apply mutation scope覆盖；Owner ref 若被 contract要求绑定 architectureCycleRef，则 canonical tuple/hash authority本身必须在合法 mutation surface内。
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Proposal，把 canonical Owner provenance consumer纳入 apply/revise-apply mutation scope，并同步 Proposal proof/expected actualChangeSet。保持现有 owner-provenance authority，不另建第二套 ref generator。
acceptance: apply 与 revise-apply mutation declarations都合法覆盖 src/domain/owner-provenance.ts。
canonicalOwnerDecisionTuple/ownerDecisionRefFor 对带 architectureCycleRef 的合法 relevant Owner record把 cycle identity纳入 hash domain。
两个其它字段相同而 architectureCycleRef 不同的 relevant records产生不同 Owner refs；reader recomputation与writer完全一致。
legacy/non-architecture Owner records保持既有 canonical refs/compatibility，不被无关字段重算破坏。
重新运行 deriveMutationDeclaration 与 expected buildVerificationSelection；core-model/serialization physical coverage仍闭合。
